title: Settlement Percentage Points by Age of the Charge-Off
content:
**Rule.** For a Charged-Off Settlement Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan charged off at least 365 calendar days before the decision date earns 15 points; a loan charged off at least 180 but fewer than 365 calendar days before it earns 10 points; a more recent charge-off earns none, the days being counted from the day after the charge-off date through the decision date and a loan with no charge-off date recorded counting no days since charge-off. The charge-off date is the one on the borrower's Personal Loans record. Each point is one percentage point off the settlement percentage.

| Calendar days from the charge-off date to the decision date | Points |
|---|---|
| 365 or more | 15 |
| 180 to 364 | 10 |
| fewer than 180, or no charge-off date recorded | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, charge-off on 1 March of a non-leap year)

- Decision on 27 August: 179 days, no points. On 28 August: 180 days, 10 points.
- Decision on 28 February of the next year: 364 days, 10 points. On 1 March of the next year: 365 days, 15 points.
